questions: Should the function preserve the original line breaks exactly, or should it treat the input as a single block and re-wrap ignoring original line breaks?
What should happen if a line contains only whitespace (e.g., spaces or tabs)? Should it be wrapped to an empty string, preserved as whitespace, or treated as a blank line?
Does the function need to handle tabs or other whitespace characters specially, e.g., convert tabs to spaces before wrapping?
Should the function trim trailing whitespace from each line after wrapping, or preserve exact whitespace from textwrap.fill?
Is the regular expression substitution (replacing 'is' with 'was') a mandatory part of the function, or is it just an example in the reference solution?
Should the width parameter be interpreted as a maximum line length in characters, and does it include or exclude newline characters?
What should happen if width is zero or negative? Should it raise an error, return empty string, or treat as unlimited?
Should the function preserve leading/trailing newlines in the input string (e.g., a newline at the very beginning or end)?
